Documentation.short_help: SHYX Selection Append Patches: Add overlapping extracted patches into a PartitionedDataSetCollection.
Documentation.long_help: Snapshots cell selections into the patch table (default names geo_0, geo_1, ...). Rename only; names need not end with _N. The table keeps every row. Apply merges rows with the same name into one output patch and reuses the earlier mark. Unique names are marked 0, 1, 2, ... in table order (constant cell/field array Mark Array Name, default PatchMark). Apply runs vtkExtractSelection per unique name. Patches may overlap; unselected parent cells are not appended; no GlobalIds.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: Parent mesh. Cell ids in the patch table refer to this dataset.

InputProperty.name: Selection
InputProperty.label: Selection
InputProperty.Documentation: Optional live vtkSelection. Hidden from the default panel: Add from selection reads the 3D-view selection directly (Copy Active Selection is not required). Used when the patch table is empty (single geo_0) or as an Add fallback / Python SelectionInput.

StringVectorProperty.name: MarkArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Mark Array Name
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Name of the constant cell/field array written on each extracted patch.

StringVectorProperty.name: PatchNames
StringVectorProperty.label: Patch Names
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated patch names (table Name column; one line per table row, duplicates kept). Apply merges duplicate names into one output patch and reuses the earlier mark. Unique names are marked 0, 1, 2, ... in first-seen order. Shown via the Patches table, not as a raw text box.

StringVectorProperty.name: PatchCellIds
StringVectorProperty.label: Patch Cell Ids
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated cell-id lists aligned with Patch Names. Comma-separated ids or ranges (0-10,15) on the Input dataset.
